projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
An analytics dashboard project that ingests and processes customer CSV files, analyzes application logs, and presents insights through visualization components. Scope spans the data ingestion/processing pipeline, log analysis pipeline, and a frontend dashboard with interactive charts and reporting.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-processing, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: M1: Project Setup & Data Foundations
tasks.details: Milestone tracking container (not directly executable — all effort is estimated and tracked in its child tasks; 26h across 5 child tasks). Scope: establish the technical foundation for the analytics dashboard — repository scaffolding, environment configuration, the analytical data store schema, and shared data model conventions used by both the CSV and log pipelines. Exit criteria: a running local development environment, documented schema, and agreed data contracts.

tasks.name: M2: Customer CSV Data Processing Pipeline
tasks.details: Milestone tracking container (not directly executable — all effort is estimated and tracked in its child tasks; 56h across 8 child tasks). Scope: build an end-to-end pipeline that ingests customer CSV files, validates and cleans records, and loads normalized customer data into the analytical store — schema validation, deduplication, PII handling, and a scheduled ingestion job. Exit criteria: a representative customer CSV file flows from upload to a queryable table with row-level quality metrics.

tasks.name: M3: Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details: Milestone tracking container (not directly executable — all effort is estimated and tracked in its child tasks; 52h across 8 child tasks). Scope: build a pipeline that collects application logs, parses them into structured events, and produces aggregated metrics such as error rates, request latency distributions, and top failure signatures — log parsing, enrichment, aggregation windows, and retention policy. Exit criteria: logs from a sample application run produce queryable metrics and a documented event schema.

tasks.name: M4: Visualization Components & Dashboard UI
tasks.details: Milestone tracking container (not directly executable — all effort is estimated and tracked in its child tasks; 72h across 11 child tasks). Scope: deliver the dashboard user interface and reusable visualization components — app shell and routing, a chart component library, customer analytics views, log/operational health views, filtering, and export. Exit criteria: all primary dashboard pages render real data from the analytical store with responsive layout and loading/error states.

tasks.name: M5: Integration, Testing & Deployment
tasks.details: Milestone tracking container (not directly executable — all effort is estimated and tracked in its child tasks; 64h across 9 child tasks). Scope: harden and ship the dashboard — API layer between pipelines and UI, automated test suites, performance tuning, pipeline orchestration/scheduling, observability, and production deployment with documentation. Exit criteria: CI pipeline green, end-to-end smoke test passes in staging, and the dashboard is deployed with runbooks.

tasks.name: Repository scaffolding & tooling
tasks.details: Create the monorepo/workspace structure for pipelines and frontend, initialize package/tooling configs, linting and formatting rules, and commit hooks. Done when a fresh clone can install dependencies and run lint successfully.

tasks.name: Local dev environment with containerized services
tasks.details: Provide docker-compose (or equivalent) for the analytical database, object/file storage for CSV drops, and local log storage. Include seed scripts and a single command to bring the stack up. Done when the full local stack starts cleanly from scratch.

tasks.name: Analytical data store schema design
tasks.details: Design tables/models for customers, orders/events, log events, and pre-aggregated metrics. Include keys, partitioning approach, indexes, and migration scripts. Done when migrations run against the local database and a schema diagram is documented.

tasks.name: Shared data contracts & type definitions
tasks.details: Define typed interfaces/JSON schemas for customer records, log events, and API responses shared between pipelines and the dashboard. Include validation helpers. Done when both pipeline and frontend import the same generated/shared types without duplication.

tasks.name: Developer onboarding docs & conventions
tasks.details: Write README covering setup, repo layout, branching/conventions, and how to run each pipeline locally. Keep it short and task-oriented. Done when a new contributor can follow it end-to-end without assistance.

tasks.name: CSV upload endpoint & file intake
tasks.details: Implement an upload endpoint (or watched-folder ingestion) that accepts customer CSV files, stores them in the ingestion bucket with checksums, and registers an ingestion record with status and metadata. Done when a file upload creates a tracked ingestion row and is retrievable.

tasks.name: CSV schema validation & error reporting
tasks.details: Validate headers, column types, required fields, and date/currency formats against the customer schema. Produce a per-row error report with reasons and reject malformed files with actionable messages. Done when valid files pass and a deliberately corrupted fixture fails with clear diagnostics.

tasks.name: Cleaning, deduplication & normalization transforms
tasks.details: Implement transforms that trim/normalize strings, standardize dates and country/state codes, coerce numeric fields, and deduplicate customers by business key with a documented survivorship rule. Done when transforms are unit-tested against representative messy fixtures.

tasks.name: PII masking & data retention policy
tasks.details: Identify PII columns (email, phone, address), apply masking or hashing at rest, and document retention/access rules. Add tests asserting raw PII is not persisted in analytics tables. Done when PII policy is reviewed and enforced by tests.

tasks.name: Customer warehouse loader (upsert)
tasks.details: Load cleaned, validated customer records into the analytical store using idempotent upserts keyed on customer ID. Handle partial batches and record load counts. Done when re-running the same file produces no duplicate rows.

tasks.name: Data quality metrics & ingestion reporting
tasks.details: Emit per-ingestion quality metrics: rows read, accepted, rejected, duplicates removed, null rates per column, and processing duration. Expose them via a query/endpoint for the dashboard. Done when a sample ingestion produces a complete metrics record.

tasks.name: Scheduled ingestion job & retry handling
tasks.details: Wrap the CSV pipeline in a scheduled job that polls the ingestion bucket, retries transient failures with backoff, and marks permanent failures with reasons. Done when a scheduled run processes a new file unattended and failures are visibly recorded.

tasks.name: CSV pipeline integration tests with fixtures
tasks.details: Build a fixture suite covering happy path, malformed rows, duplicate records, encoding issues, and large-file behavior; run the full pipeline end-to-end in tests. Done when the suite runs in CI and covers the key failure modes.

tasks.name: Log collection & shipping configuration
tasks.details: Configure collection of application logs (file tailing or agent-based) into the local/analytical log store, including rotation handling and backpressure settings. Done when logs from a running sample app land in the store within seconds.

tasks.name: Log parser & structured event mapping
tasks.details: Parse application log lines into a structured event schema (timestamp, level, service, message, trace/request ID, duration, error code) with graceful handling of unknown formats. Done when a sample corpus parses with a measured success rate and unmapped lines are quarantined.

tasks.name: Log event enrichment
tasks.details: Enrich parsed events with service/environment metadata, normalized severity, coarse geo/IP classification where applicable, and request correlation IDs to link related lines. Done when enrichment is applied in the pipeline and covered by unit tests.

tasks.name: Aggregation job: request counts & error rates
tasks.details: Compute windowed (per minute/hour/day) counts of requests and error rates broken down by level, status code, and service, writing to the pre-aggregated metrics table. Done when counts and error rates reconcile with a hand-computed fixture for a fixed time window. Latency percentiles are handled in a separate task.

tasks.name: Failure signature extraction (top errors grouping)
tasks.details: Group error events into normalized signatures by stripping volatile values (IDs, timestamps, numbers) and rank by frequency/impact. Done when the top-N signature report matches expected groupings on a labeled fixture set.

tasks.name: Log retention & partitioning strategy
tasks.details: Define retention windows for raw vs. aggregated log data, implement time-based partitioning and a purge job, and document storage/query trade-offs. Done when the purge job removes expired partitions in a dry-run test.

tasks.name: Log pipeline tests with sample log corpus
tasks.details: Assemble a labeled sample log corpus covering multiple formats, malformed lines, and multi-line stack traces; write tests for parsing, enrichment, and aggregation. Done when tests run in CI and report parse accuracy.

tasks.name: Frontend app shell, routing & layout
tasks.details: Set up the dashboard frontend framework, app layout (sidebar/header/content), route structure for each dashboard section, and a data-fetching layer stub. Done when navigation between placeholder pages works with no console errors.

tasks.name: Design tokens & base UI primitives
tasks.details: Define color, spacing, and typography tokens plus reusable primitives (Card, Button, Badge, Tooltip, Skeleton). Done when primitives are documented in a local component gallery and meet contrast requirements.

tasks.name: Chart component library (line, bar, stat tile)
tasks.details: Build wrapper components around the chosen charting library for time-series line, categorical bar, and single-value stat tiles, with consistent axes, legends, and tooltips. Done when each chart renders from typed mock data and is reusable across pages.

tasks.name: Sortable/filterable data table component
tasks.details: Build a reusable data table with column sorting, pagination, client-side filtering, and CSV export hook, designed for customer and log datasets. Done when it renders 10k mock rows without layout or performance regressions.

tasks.name: Customer analytics overview page
tasks.details: Compose KPI tiles (total/active/new customers, growth rate) and trend charts backed by customer metrics. Include loading, empty, and error states. Done when the page renders live data from the analytical store.

tasks.name: Customer segment explorer page
tasks.details: Build an interactive view to segment customers by region, cohort, and value tier, with a drill-down table using the data table component. Done when filters update charts and table consistently.

tasks.name: Operational health page (errors & latency)
tasks.details: Compose log-metric views: error-rate over time, latency percentiles, top failure signatures, and service breakdown. Done when the page renders pipeline aggregates and links to filtered log detail.

tasks.name: Global filter bar & URL-synced state
tasks.details: Implement a date-range and segment filter bar that syncs to the URL so views are shareable, and wire it into all dashboard pages. Done when changing a filter updates the URL and every page respects it.

tasks.name: Loading, empty & error state patterns
tasks.details: Standardize skeletons, empty-state messaging, and error/retry UI across all dashboard widgets, including a top-level error boundary. Done when every page has verified states for slow, empty, and failed requests.

tasks.name: Report/CSV export from dashboard views
tasks.details: Add export actions that download the currently filtered chart data or table view as CSV, with sensible filenames and column headers. Done when exports match on-screen filters for both customer and log views.

tasks.name: Responsive layout & accessibility pass
tasks.details: Verify and fix responsive breakpoints for tablet/mobile and run an accessibility audit (keyboard nav, labels, contrast, chart alternatives). Done when the audit checklist passes with no critical issues.

tasks.name: Dashboard API endpoints for metrics
tasks.details: Expose read endpoints for customer KPIs, segmentation, log error rates, latency percentiles, and failure signatures, with typed responses and validated query params. Done when each endpoint returns matching contract types from seeded data.

tasks.name: API caching & query performance tuning
tasks.details: Add response caching for expensive metric queries, review query plans for the top dashboard queries, and add indexes where needed. Done when p95 dashboard API latency meets the agreed target on seeded data.

tasks.name: Unit test suite for pipeline transforms
tasks.details: Raise unit coverage on CSV and log transforms, parsers, and aggregators with focused tests for edge cases. Done when coverage targets are met and tests run fast in CI.

tasks.name: Frontend component & end-to-end tests
tasks.details: Add component tests for chart and table primitives plus e2e tests covering navigation, filtering, and export flows. Done when the e2e suite passes against the local stack.

tasks.name: Pipeline orchestration & scheduling
tasks.details: Define the DAG/order of CSV ingestion, log processing, and aggregation jobs with dependencies and concurrency limits using the chosen scheduler. Done when the full pipeline runs on a schedule end-to-end without manual steps.

tasks.name: Observability: metrics, logging & alerts
tasks.details: Instrument pipeline jobs and API with structured logs, run metrics, and failure alerts (job failure, ingestion lag, API error rate). Done when a simulated job failure triggers an alert.

tasks.name: CI/CD pipeline setup
tasks.details: Configure CI to run lint, unit, integration, and build steps on every PR; define environment-specific deploy jobs with secrets management. Done when the CI pipeline is green on the main branch and gates merges.

tasks.name: Staging deployment & end-to-end smoke test
tasks.details: Deploy all services to staging, load a representative dataset, run the smoke test covering ingestion to dashboard display, and verify the exit criteria for milestones M2-M4. Done when staging passes the full smoke run.

tasks.name: Production deployment & runbooks
tasks.details: Deploy to production, configure backups and alerts, and write runbooks for pipeline failures, data backfills, and rollback. Done when production is live and the on-call runbook is reviewed.

tasks.name: Aggregation job: latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99)
tasks.details: Compute windowed latency percentiles (p50, p95, p99) and average duration per service and endpoint from parsed request-duration fields, storing them in the metrics table. Done when percentile outputs match a hand-computed fixture and empty/sparse windows are handled.
